You must answer on the enclosed answer booklet.
You will need: Answer booklet (enclosed)
Answer one question from your chosen Depth Study.
Follow the instructions on the front cover of the answer booklet. If you need additional answer paper,
ask the invigilator for a continuation booklet.
Answer one question from your chosen Depth Study.
DEPTH STUDY A: THE FIRST WORLD WAR, 1914–18
1 How important was the ‘race to the sea’ as a reason for a prolonged war? Explain your answer.
How significant was the German Revolution as a reason for the Armistice in 1918? Explain your
answer.
DEPTH STUDY B: GERMANY, 1918–45
How important were reparations as a cause of disorder in Weimar Germany, 1919–23? Explain
your answer. [40]
How significant was the Depression in securing support for the Nazi Party up to 1933? Explain your
answer. [40]
DEPTH STUDY C: RUSSIA, 1905–41
How important was Lenin in the consolidation of Bolshevik rule, 1917–24? Explain your answer.
How significant were economic factors in Stalin’s introduction of the Five-Year Plans? Explain your
answer. [40]
DEPTH STUDY D: THE UNITED STATES, 1919–41
How important were tariffs as a reason why farmers did not share in the prosperity of the 1920s?
Explain your answer. [40]
How significant was President Hoover’s reaction to the Bonus Marchers as a reason for his defeat
in the Presidential election in 1932? Explain your answer.
DEPTH STUDY E: CHINA, c.1930–c.1990
How important was the First Five-Year Plan to China’s social and economic development by 1960?
Explain your answer.
How significant was the Cultural Revolution in changing life for the Chinese people? Explain your
answer. [40]
DEPTH STUDY F: SOUTH AFRICA, c.1940–c.1994
How important were government policies on schools in maintaining apartheid after 1948? Explain
your answer. [40]
How significant was Steve Biko in the development of the anti-apartheid movement in South Africa?
Explain your answer.
DEPTH STUDY G: ISRAELIS AND PALESTINIANS SINCE 1945
How important was disunity between Israel’s enemies in determining the outcome of the 1948–49
war? Explain your answer. [40]
How significant have the Palestinians been in the development of the Arab-Israeli dispute? Explain
your answer. [40]
